name: Again Into the Great Ossuary
label: Quest
description: Again Into the Great Ossuary: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Are you headed back into the Scholomance, friend? You've already paid such a great price for the use of the Divination Scryer - perhaps you'd like to take another one with you. With it, you'd be able to face the perils of the Great Ossuary once more.
By all means, have it. You've certainly earned it.
